title: Install Motherboard Standoffs
instruction: Thread brass motherboard standoffs into the chassis tray matching your motherboard form factor (ATX).
hint: Skipping standoffs will cause direct contact between motherboard solder points and metal chassis, causing an electrical short circuit.

title: Unlatch Socket & Seat CPU
instruction: Lift the CPU retention arm, align the golden triangle marker on the processor with the socket corner notch, and lower into place with zero insertion force.
hint: Never force or slide the CPU across pins. Close the retention load plate and latch the lever down securely.

title: Install RAM in Dual-Channel Slots
instruction: Open the locking clips on memory slots DIMM 2 and DIMM 4 (A2 and B2). Align the module key notch and press firmly on both ends until latches click.
hint: Populating A2 and B2 first ensures optimal signal reflection impedance for high-speed memory stability.

title: Mount M.2 NVMe SSD
instruction: Insert M.2 NVMe SSD at a 30-degree angle into the primary CPU-connected M.2 slot, push down gently, and tighten the mounting screw.
hint: Remove any protective blue plastic film from motherboard heatsink thermal pads before reattaching the heatsink.

title: Apply Thermal Compound
instruction: Dispense a pea-sized dot (~4-5mm diameter) of non-conductive thermal paste onto the center of the CPU heat spreader.
hint: The mounting pressure of the cooler baseplate will spread the paste evenly across the contact area.

title: Mount CPU Cooler & Connect Fan Header
instruction: Place cooler baseplate onto CPU, tighten retention screws in an alternating diagonal cross pattern, and connect 4-pin PWM cable to CPU_FAN header.
hint: Connecting to SYS_FAN instead of CPU_FAN may trigger a BIOS 'CPU Fan Speed Error' on first boot.

title: Secure Motherboard Into Chassis
instruction: Install rear I/O shield (if not integrated), slide motherboard ports into shield opening, align with standoffs, and tighten screws evenly.
hint: Do not overtighten motherboard screws; snug firmness is sufficient to avoid cracking PCB traces.

title: Mount PSU & Route Primary Power Cables
instruction: Slide PSU into bottom chassis shroud with fan facing intake vent. Connect 24-pin ATX Main, 8-pin EPS 12V CPU, and PCIe cables.
hint: The 8-pin EPS cable feeds direct power to VRMs. Forgetting this cable results in spinning fans but no CPU initialization or POST.

title: Install Dedicated GPU & Auxiliary Power
instruction: Remove case expansion slot covers, insert GPU into top PCIe 4.0/5.0 x16 slot until latch clicks, secure chassis bracket screws, and plug in PCIe power cables.
hint: Always plug your monitor HDMI/DisplayPort cable directly into the GPU, NOT the motherboard video outputs.

title: Power Switch & POST Diagnostic Test
instruction: Flip rear PSU rocker switch to 'I' (On) and press front panel power switch. Observe motherboard Q-LED diagnostic indicators and listen for boot beep code.
hint: A single short beep indicates successful POST and handoff to UEFI firmware.
